article.title: Google推出Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，原生影片延長至15秒
article.title_en: Google launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with native video up to 15 seconds
article.summary: 11月5日公告加入多輪對話修改，API與商務平台開放，部分應用仍按方案推出。
article.summary_en: The November 5 release adds conversational edits, with API and business access while some app features roll out by plan.
highlights: 影片可按一秒單位設定3至15秒。
可在同一片段修改背景、光線或畫面比例，毋須每次重新起稿。
highlights_en: Native duration can be set from 3 to 15 seconds in one-second steps.
The same clip can be revised for background, lighting or aspect ratio.
article.why: 短片團隊可先完成一個概念，再修改成不同版位素材，減少重複提交簡報的工序。
article.why_en: Video teams can develop one concept and revise it for placements, reducing repeated briefing steps.
article.next_step: 用已獲授權的商品參考照試做一個片段，逐格核對包裝字樣、人物及連續動作。
article.next_step_en: Test one clip with authorized product references and inspect packaging text, people and motion frame by frame.
article.detail: Google稱模型改善參考素材與角色一致性，這仍屬公司對能力的描述，並非每次輸出的保證。公告把API及商務平台的正式開放，與Gemini應用向Ultra訂戶推出的安排分開列明；各帳戶應查實際權限。快速運動、劇本急轉及複雜物理效果仍是待改善項目。正式廣告製作宜保留原始參考、修改紀錄及人手審核，不能只看示範片便判定可直接交付。
article.detail_en: Reference consistency is a vendor capability claim, not a guarantee. API/business availability differs from the Gemini app’s Ultra rollout. Google identifies fast action and complex physics as ongoing work. Retain references, revision history and human production checks.
